task.description: Validate the CODE-DESIGNER Step 01 design for DDL-02, ORD-01, ORD-02, ORD-04. Standard checks apply. Additionally: verify the design's claim that src/effects/worker.zig/queue.zig is a genuine, correctly-cited existing FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED pattern to follow (read those files yourself). Verify the design's argument that ORD-02's per-correlation advisory lock is NOT redundant with SKIP LOCKED (unlike a previously-removed per-timer lock referenced as ISS-301 precedent) -- read that precedent/history if cited and confirm the distinction is sound, since getting this backwards would mean reintroducing a documented anti-pattern. Verify DDL-02 correctly extends ddl_validate.zig's existing ValidatePlatformDDL pipeline rather than creating a parallel validator. Check if docs/processes/system/effect-reentry-ordering.md (cited by the designer as an authoritative process spec for PW-07) genuinely exists and the design is consistent with it.
acceptance_criteria: Every AC in DDL-02, ORD-01, ORD-02, ORD-04 traced to a design section
No implementation code in the design
DDL-02 extends the existing validator pipeline correctly
ORD-02 lock-non-redundancy argument verified sound against the cited ISS-301/removed-lock precedent
